demos.dialogue_line: Mesa Jar Jar Binks. You're a Gungan, aren't you? How'd you end up here with us? My no know. Mesa day starten pitty okeyday witda brisky morning munchen. Den boom! Getten berry scared... ...and grabben dat Jedi, and pow... mesa here. Mesa getten berry, berry scared.
demos.speaker: Jar Jar Binks

demos.dialogue_line: Why were you banished, Jar Jar?
demos.speaker: Obi-Wan Kenobi

demos.dialogue_line: We'll need a navigator to get us through the planet's core. This Gungan may be of help. What is to become of Jar Jar Binks here?
demos.speaker: Qui-Gon Jinn
